api.name: 有報LAB
api.description: 有報LAB (YuhoLAB): data on Japanese listed companies, extracted from annual securities reports (有価証券報告書) and other filings published on EDINET by Japan's Financial Services Agency. Start with search_companies to resolve a 4-digit ticker code (e.g. 7203), then call the per-company tools. Amounts are million JPY and ratios are percent unless a response says otherwise. Figures are processed from the original filings and may differ from them; check EDINET for the source documents. Information only, not investment advice. All tools are read-only.

endpoints.description: Search listed issuers by ticker code or company name. Returns code, name, market, sector and location for each match.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query (ticker code or company name).

endpoints.description: Annual financial summary (levels such as sales, operating_profit and net_profit). Amounts in million JPY; ratios in percent.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Issuer ticker code (e.g. 6758).

parameters.name: years
parameters.description: How many years of summary to return.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response keys to include (e.g. sales,operating_profit,net_profit).

200.description: Financial summary, proxied unchanged. Must-preserve JSON keys: sales, operating_profit, net_profit.

sales.description: Sales / revenue. Amount in million JPY. Gateway must not rename this key.

operating_profit.description: Operating profit. Amount in million JPY. Gateway must not rename this key.

net_profit.description: Net profit. Amount in million JPY. Gateway must not rename this key.

endpoints.description: Every screen_index row in columnar form, for on-device screening in the iOS app. Supports conditional GET. Private: allowlisted at the gateway but not published in OpenAPI, skills or MCP tools.

Answers a question about one issuer from its annual report data, streamed as server-sent events. Body: {code, messages:[{role, content}]}. Private, and capped per consumer at 5 per minute and 10 per day because each call runs an LLM.
